typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		BatchDate as date,
		RunDate as timestamp,
		LastName as string,
		FirstName as string,
		MI as string,
		HCID as string,
		FallOutReason as string,
		GroupID as string,
		ClassID as string,
		ContractID as string,
		PBP as string,
		PlanName as string,
		PlanType as string,
		CoverageType as string,
		OSBIndicator as string,
		WriteOffReason as string,
		LastDue as timestamp,
		TotalAmount as string,
		PPAInd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::gv_populatefalloutrptquery',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of PBP} = toString(PBP),
		{Copy of OSBIndicator} = toString(OSBIndicator),
		{Copy of PlanName} = toString(PlanName),
		{Copy of ClassID} = toString(ClassID),
		{Copy of GroupID} = toString(GroupID),
		{Copy of MI} = toString(MI),
		{Copy of WriteOffReason} = toString(WriteOffReason),
		{Copy of LastName} = toString(LastName),
		{Copy of RunDate} = toString(RunDate),
		{Copy of PPAInd} = toString(PPAInd),
		{Copy of LastDue} = toString(LastDue),
		{Copy of FallOutReason} = toString(FallOutReason),
		{Copy of PlanType} = toString(PlanType),
		{Copy of TotalAmount} = toString(TotalAmount),
		{Copy of HCID} = toString(HCID),
		{Copy of ContractID} = toString(ContractID),
		{Copy of BatchDate} = toString(BatchDate),
		{Copy of FirstName} = toString(FirstName),
		{Copy of CoverageType} = toString(CoverageType)) ~> DataConversion
